commits: f6ded59 selfhost: w3-accept: pre-test S4/S5 with a hand-built 128 MiB OUT.IMG
purpose: Pre-test the host-side acceptance stages S4 (extract OUT.IMG, boot it, assert kernel marker) and S5 (boot OUT.IMG, run an in-OS-built program) with a hand-built 128 MiB FAT16 OUT.IMG (mtools mformat/mcopy only), extending tools/run_selfhost_build_test.py where needed, and produce the exact requirements for what the real in-OS-built OUT.IMG must contain for S5 to pass.
summary: S4 and S5 are now EXERCISED code paths with gated, serial-backed evidence. A hand-built 128 MiB FAT16 OUT.IMG (BPB bps=512 spc=4 nfats=2 root=512 fatsize=256 total=262144, matching dosfstools at the frozen size; mformat -F means FAT32, the FAT16 recipe is truncate + plain mformat) was planted on a 1 GiB pre-test boot disk (real DESKTOP shape + SELFHOST.BIN + SELFHOST.RUN + BOOTAA64.EFI + kernel). Full-runner Run A: S4 extracted OUT.IMG (134,217,728 B) with byte-identity (sha256 93a2f80a… == hand-built master), booted it (kernel marker ok 6.5 s), S5 booted it again with QMP and launched OUTPROG.BIN from the OUT.IMG Apps menu ([MENU] 5=OUTPROG.BIN; [LAUNCH] OUTPROG.BIN; [KERNEL] Process 3: OUTPROG.BIN exited on serial) — S4/S5 green. Driver part still clean stage_failure at s0 (no MAKE.BIN — honest, in-OS toolchain is the remaining gate). Run B (kernel-less OUT.IMG, program+marker only) classifies stage_failure 'S4 failed: OUT.IMG did not reach the kernel marker' with S5 blocked — the documented expected class for a bare FAT16 (AAVMF: 'No bootable option or device was found.'). W3 finding: a standalone OUT.IMG boots only with the limine/AAVMF layout AND the S5 desktop path REQUIRES DESKTOP.BIN (+ shell set) on OUT.IMG — the kernel's DESKTOP mode parallel-loads DESKTOP.BIN from the boot-disk root; without it no Apps menu ever appears (first S5 attempt proved the negative). OUT.IMG content requirement documented in acceptance.md §8.

gates.runner_s4_s5_exercised: PASS — run A: s4.status=extracted, s4.bytes=134217728, s4.boot_ok=true (6.5 s), s5.status=run, s5.boot_ok=true, s5.menu_index=5, s5.launch_line=true, s5.exit_line=true, exit 0 via --expected-class stage_failure. run B: s4.boot_ok=false -> final stage_failure 'S4 failed: OUT.IMG did not reach the kernel marker', exit 0 via --expected-class stage_failure. Classifier self-test 7/7.

Host re-extraction of OUTPROG.BIN from the runner file == obj/arm/hello.bin sha256 7110d326…; OUTMARK.TXT content intact.

artifacts: tools/run_selfhost_build_test.py (S5 stage, S4 sha256+boot, --s5-program/--s5-wait, S4/S5 verdict override)
fat16img.py (linear read_file: 128 MiB extract 1 s vs O(n^2) hang)
tools/w3_accept_pretest.sh (reproducible hand OUT.IMG min+bootable + 1 GiB pre-test boot disk)

requirements_for_real_S5.out_img_size: 128 MiB FAT16, frozen (DOSFSTOOLS DISK_BLOCKS=131072 = 1024-byte units; file = 134,217,728 B; mformat -T is 512-byte sectors, -F means FAT32 — the proven host recipe is truncate -s 134217728 + mformat; the in-OS MKFSFAT port produces the same geometry: bps=512 spc=4 nfats=2)
must_contain: /boot/limine.conf (verbatim ARM template: timeout 0 / default_entry 1 / protocol linux / path boot():/boot/hobbyos.bin)
/boot/hobbyos.bin (kernel flat binary, llvm-objcopy of the in-OS-built ELF)
/DESKTOP.BIN (REQUIRED — kernel DESKTOP mode parallel-loads it at boot; without it no Apps menu for S5's keystroke path; w3 empirical finding)
<S1 program>.BIN at root with an 8.3 name (the program S5 launches; OUTPROG.BIN proven)
a marker file for the host file-based check (OUTMARK.TXT proven, acceptance §5.4)
requirements_for_real_S5.s5_program_launch_mechanism: verified today via the desktop Apps menu (QMP input-send-event keystrokes) with loader-line evidence ([LAUNCH] <prog>, [KERNEL] Process N: <prog> exited); program stdout is framebuffer-only so its own marker needs the MODE=selfhost serial-console-fd driver (kernel follow-up, acceptance §5.2 primary drive)
requirements_for_real_S5.s3_in_os_recipe: the in-OS S3 recipe (Makefile.hobbyos disk) must produce exactly the layout above — DESKTOP is not optional in AD-9's user set for the desktop S5 path
prereqs_before_real_run: in-OS toolchain MAKE.BIN + clang in /TOOLS (S0-S3 real execution)
w2-mkfs kernel gap: MKFSFAT -C content writes into ftruncate-extended files must persist (extend-then-write)
MODE=selfhost boot mode (kernel lane) for program markers on serial

remaining_harness_work: MODE=selfhost + SELFHOST.BIN serial-console-fd stdout (kernel lane) — replaces the keystroke path, gives [SELFHOST]/program markers on serial
isolate whether CONSOLE.BIN is strictly required on OUT.IMG or only DESKTOP.BIN + SH.BIN (present together in the w3 run; not isolated)
hang classifier real-boot case once the toolchain exists (a wedged cc1) — currently unit-only
full acceptance run: driver completes (ACCEPTANCE-COMPLETE, zero FAIL tokens) + s4.boot_ok + s5.launch_line + program marker (item 1) -> success
blockers: no in-OS MAKE.BIN/toolchain yet — S0-S3 cannot run for real, so the real OUT.IMG does not exist; S4/S5 are pre-tested with the hand-built image (this lane's whole purpose)
w2-mkfs kernel gap (extend-then-write on FAT16) blocks MKFSFAT -C from producing OUT.IMG in-OS
agent command blocklist: mkfs.fat and dd unusable for scratch images; mtools mformat/mcopy used instead (L5-proven, kernel mounts fine)
notes: The mformat -F=FAT32 pitfall is now documented in the assembly script and acceptance.md §8. The runner's S4/S5 run automatically once OUT.IMG exists on the staged disk (root or /SRC), so no new runner work is needed for the real acceptance run. Heuristics: OUT.IMG at the boot-disk root shifted SELFHOST.BIN's Apps-menu index (5 in w2 -> 9 here) — the runner reads the actual [MENU] dump, so indexes are never hardcoded. One QEMU per tree at a time; fuser -k only on own images; no make clean; no broad pkill observed.
